# Burnly v0.1.14

This release improves the tray experience and fixes local usage refreshes on
Windows.

## What's Improved

- Windows refreshes now continue when an unused source has no data.
- Cline and ZCode usage is detected correctly from the normal Windows user
  profile location.
- The tray panel uses a smoother custom scrollbar that fades away when idle.

## Install

Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-linux.sh | sh
```

Windows preview:

Download `burnly-v0.1.14-windows-x86_64.exe` from this release.

macOS preview:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-macos.sh | sh
```

Windows and macOS builds are unsigned previews. Only download Burnly from the
official GitHub release.
